pages.text: A long wooden slide stood on the slope. Its top was high above.
Mei wanted a turn too and went up to the steps.
Ppino zoomed down. Rudi zoomed down too.
Mei climbed one step. Looking down made their legs tremble.
Mei came back down. "I'll watch from below."
The four took several turns each. Mei just stood by the steps and counted.
The sun was setting. Mei shifted their toes by the steps.
Grandma Bear stood at the bottom of the slide. "I'll catch you down here."
Mei sat at the top and looked down. Grandma's arms were open wide.
Mei zoomed down, right into Grandma's arms. "I want another turn!"
